```{r}
#Functions that help
#Nabs warnings from a loop
withWarnings <- function(expr) {
  myWarnings <- NULL
  wHandler <- function(w) {
    myWarnings <<- c(myWarnings, list(w))
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }
  val <- withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = wHandler)
  list(value = val, warnings = myWarnings)
} 
set.seed(68)
```

```{r}

#subcorttotal
vars <- subcortical_totals
vars <- vars[vars %in% names(PheWAS_baseline)]
is_num <- sapply(PheWAS_baseline[vars], is.numeric)
vars <- vars[is_num]

# Trimester-specific WHIIRS predictors
whiirs_terms <- c("whiirs_t1", "whiirs_t2", "whiirs_t3")

# fixed effects
preds_fixed <- c(
  whiirs_terms,
  "total_brain_volume_volume",
  "mom_cannabis_use",
  "maternal_age_birth",
  "income_needs_demo",
  "child_sex"
)


out <- data.frame(Variable = vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
  out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("FDR_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
}

out$Singular <- NA
out$Group <- "Subcortical"

ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  v <- vars[i]
  y <- PheWAS_baseline[[v]]
  
  if (all(is.na(y)) || isTRUE(var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)) next
  
  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
  
  for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
    if (!tm %in% rownames(cf)) next
    
    out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Estimate"]
    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]
    out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  out$Singular[i] <- isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

pcols <- paste0("Pval_", whiirs_terms)
out <- out[rowSums(!is.na(out[, pcols, drop = FALSE])) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
  pcol <- paste0("Pval_", tm)
  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)
  
  idx <- which(!is.na(out[[pcol]]))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    out[[fcol]][idx] <- p.adjust(out[[pcol]][idx], method = "fdr")
  }
}

whiirs_Results_subcort <- out[, c(
  "Variable",
  "Beta_whiirs_t1", "STE_whiirs_t1", "Pval_whiirs_t1", "FDR_whiirs_t1",
  "Beta_whiirs_t2", "STE_whiirs_t2", "Pval_whiirs_t2", "FDR_whiirs_t2",
  "Beta_whiirs_t3", "STE_whiirs_t3", "Pval_whiirs_t3", "FDR_whiirs_t3",
  "Singular", "Group"
)]

whiirs_Results_subcort <- whiirs_Results_subcort[order(whiirs_Results_subcort$Variable), ]

write.csv(
  whiirs_Results_subcort,
  "~/Downloads/whiirs_Results_subcort_total.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

  out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("FDR_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
}

out$Singular <- NA
out$Group <- "thickness"

ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  v <- vars[i]
  y <- PheWAS_baseline[[v]]
  
  if (all(is.na(y)) || isTRUE(var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)) next
  
  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
  
  for (tm in whiirs_terms) {

    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]

  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)

  "child_sex"
)


out <- data.frame(Variable = vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
  out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("FDR_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
}

out$Singular <- NA
out$Group <- "ra"

ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  v <- vars[i]
  y <- PheWAS_baseline[[v]]
  
  if (all(is.na(y)) || isTRUE(var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)) next
  
  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
  
  for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
    if (!tm %in% rownames(cf)) next
    
    out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Estimate"]
    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]
    out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  out$Singular[i] <- isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

pcols <- paste0("Pval_", whiirs_terms)
out <- out[rowSums(!is.na(out[, pcols, drop = FALSE])) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

for (tm in whiirs_terms) {
  pcol <- paste0("Pval_", tm)
  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)
  
  idx <- which(!is.na(out[[pcol]]))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    out[[fcol]][idx] <- p.adjust(out[[pcol]][idx], method = "fdr")
  }
}

whiirs_Results_subcort <- out[, c(
  "Variable",
  "Beta_whiirs_t1", "STE_whiirs_t1", "Pval_whiirs_t1", "FDR_whiirs_t1",
  "Beta_whiirs_t2", "STE_whiirs_t2", "Pval_whiirs_t2", "FDR_whiirs_t2",
  "Beta_whiirs_t3", "STE_whiirs_t3", "Pval_whiirs_t3", "FDR_whiirs_t3",
  "Singular", "Group"
)]

  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
```
  
```{r}
  for (tm in rls_terms) {
    if (!tm %in% rownames(cf)) next
    
    out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Estimate"]
    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]
    out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  out$Singular[i] <- isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

pcols <- paste0("Pval_", rls_terms)
out <- out[rowSums(!is.na(out[, pcols, drop = FALSE])) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

for (tm in rls_terms) {
  pcol <- paste0("Pval_", tm)
  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)
  
  idx <- which(!is.na(out[[pcol]]))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    out[[fcol]][idx] <- p.adjust(out[[pcol]][idx], method = "fdr")
  }
}
```

```{r}
## gi_totals
vars <- gi_totals
vars <- vars[vars %in% names(PheWAS_baseline)]
is_num <- sapply(PheWAS_baseline[vars], is.numeric)
vars <- vars[is_num]

# Trimester-specific WHIIRS predictors
ess_terms <- c("ess_t1", "ess_t2", "ess_t3")

# fixed effects
preds_fixed <- c(
  ess_terms,
  "mrinotes_ga",
  "mom_cannabis_use",
  "maternal_age_birth",
  "income_needs_demo",
  "child_sex"
)


out <- data.frame(Variable = vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (tm in ess_terms) {
  out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]] <- NA_real_
  out[[paste0("FDR_", tm)]]  <- NA_real_
}

out$Singular <- NA
out$Group <- "gi"

ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", calc.derivs = FALSE)

for (i in seq_along(vars)) {
  v <- vars[i]
  y <- PheWAS_baseline[[v]]
  
  if (all(is.na(y)) || isTRUE(var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)) next
  
  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
  
  for (tm in ess_terms) {
    if (!tm %in% rownames(cf)) next
    
    out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Estimate"]
    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]
    out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  out$Singular[i] <- isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

pcols <- paste0("Pval_", ess_terms)
out <- out[rowSums(!is.na(out[, pcols, drop = FALSE])) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

for (tm in ess_terms) {
  pcol <- paste0("Pval_", tm)
  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)
  
  idx <- which(!is.na(out[[pcol]]))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    out[[fcol]][idx] <- p.adjust(out[[pcol]][idx], method = "fdr")
  }
}

ess_Results_subcort <- out[, c(
  "Variable",
  "Beta_ess_t1", "STE_ess_t1", "Pval_ess_t1", "FDR_ess_t1",
  "Beta_ess_t2", "STE_ess_t2", "Pval_ess_t2", "FDR_ess_t2",
  "Beta_ess_t3", "STE_ess_t3", "Pval_ess_t3", "FDR_ess_t3",
  "Singular", "Group"
)]

ess_Results_subcort <- ess_Results_subcort[order(ess_Results_subcort$Variable), ]

write.csv(
  ess_Results_subcort,
  "~/Downloads/ess_Results_gi_total.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  y <- PheWAS_baseline[[v]]
  
  if (all(is.na(y)) || isTRUE(var(y, na.rm = TRUE) == 0)) next
  
  fixed_part <- paste(preds_fixed, collapse = " + ")
  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(v, " ~ ", fixed_part, " + (1 | study_type)")
  )
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    lmer(
      fml,
      data = PheWAS_baseline,
      na.action = na.exclude,
      REML = FALSE,
      control = ctrl
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  
  cf <- coef(summary(fit))
  
  for (tm in sleepqual_terms) {
    if (!tm %in% rownames(cf)) next
    
    out[[paste0("Beta_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Estimate"]
    out[[paste0("STE_", tm)]][i]  <- cf[tm, "Std. Error"]
    out[[paste0("Pval_", tm)]][i] <- cf[tm, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  out$Singular[i] <- isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
}

pcols <- paste0("Pval_", sleepqual_terms)
out <- out[rowSums(!is.na(out[, pcols, drop = FALSE])) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

for (tm in sleepqual_terms) {
  pcol <- paste0("Pval_", tm)
  fcol <- paste0("FDR_", tm)
  
  idx <- which(!is.na(out[[pcol]]))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    out[[fcol]][idx] <- p.adjust(out[[pcol]][idx], method = "fdr")
  }
}

sleepqual_Results_subcort <- out[, c(
  "Variable",
  "Beta_sleepqual_t1", "STE_sleepqual_t1", "Pval_sleepqual_t1", "FDR_sleepqual_t1",
  "Beta_sleepqual_t2", "STE_sleepqual_t2", "Pval_sleepqual_t2", "FDR_sleepqual_t2",
  "Beta_sleepqual_t3", "STE_sleepqual_t3", "Pval_sleepqual_t3", "FDR_sleepqual_t3",
  "Singular", "Group"
)]

sleepqual_Results_subcort <- sleepqual_Results_subcort[order(sleepqual_Results_subcort$Variable), ]

write.csv(
  sleepqual_Results_subcort,
  "~/Downloads/sleepqual_Results_md_total.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
